entries.b03db9b2baaf4f8d: This business sells concrete secondary products such as revetment blocks manufactured at partner plants, interlocked natural stone products, and civil engineering sheet products for preventing soil outflow, scouring and water leakage, among others. The company group does not have its own plants and entrusts the manufacture of its products to manufacturing contractors. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,684 million.

entries.d6d653d83caadbd0: This business rents out steel formwork used to manufacture wave-dissipating foundation blocks. Consolidated subsidiaries Sansei Suiko Co., Ltd. and Toyo Suiken Co., Ltd. also rent out formwork. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,527 million.
